knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A split cord is an unsafe item. Taping it does not make it safe. The clipper is removed from use and the removal is recorded.
The nozzle is kept moving, and the skin is checked for heat. Holding hot air on one spot can burn the skin.
The lesson says a self-employed person must manage their work so that it does not put others at risk, to the extent that is reasonably practicable.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate inspect a simulated dryer, clipper, blade and cord before a simulated groom, and record the check
Assessor presents a simulated split cord and observes the candidate remove the item from use and record the removal
Assessor observes the candidate check the simulated client outlet and cable before plugging in
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Equipment inspection record for the simulated groom
Removed-from-use record for the simulated split cord
Set-up checklist with the outlet check
stopWorkCriteria: A clipper or dryer with a damaged cord is used
A dryer is left running unattended
Electrical equipment is used near standing water
